title: Helps recycle more but cheaply made
text: Helps recycle more but cheaply made. I do like that this breaks down the cans so I can fit more in the recycle can. We are major soda drinkers in our house. But the problem is...it’s pretty cheaply made. Already it’s pretty wobbly...I don’t think it’s going to hold up too much longer

product_metadata.title: Ambergron 12oz 16oz Can Crusher, Heavy Duty Wall Mounted Metal Soda Can Crusher
features: Heavy Duty Crusher: Ambergron can crusher is made with durable metal, which makes it servers much longer then others in the market.
UPGRADED Sturdy Handle: We upgraded the handle, which makes it won't apart even after thousands times of use.
Fits 16oz Cans: You can use it to crush both 12oz and 16oz cans easily.
Can Recycler: Recycling fast and easy on soda, beer, and other cans.
Wall Mounted: It can be mounted on wall or any other solid surface.
description: A Can Crusher That Saves Your Space and Time
This tool can crush your empty soda or beer cans in seconds and save a lot of space.
We choosed a better handle design so make sure it won't apart after few times of use.
